messages:
raj (eng-platform): heads-up — customer hit inconsistent 429 behavior. same api key/org: chat calls kept going for a bit, embeddings got immediate 429s. anyone seen this? :eyes:

emma (eng-runtime): saw the ticket. streaming/chat path still has the pacing shim we added last quarter; embeddings path is using the stricter token-bucket config. that mismatch explains it.

kyle (eng-api): yeah — embeddings were given a higher token_weight and a much smaller max_burst by default. it was intentional to protect cost, but it does feel jarring.

marta (eng-sre): quota-bot posted: "alert: key k-XXXX exceeded embedding-token-burst" ~ 1833056790.

olivia (product): customers will be confused if identical-key behaviour differs by endpoint. we should either unify enforcement or make it explicit in the console / response headers.

raj (eng-platform): proposal: unified enforcement layer that applies per-route multipliers for billing/cost AND a shared org-level burst pool to smooth spikes. per-key reservations remain for dedicated customers.

emma (eng-runtime): concrete: keep per-key short-window buckets for safety + per-route token buckets. add an org-shared burst_pool that per-key can draw from when its local bucket is exhausted. implement draw as preemptible credit.

kyle (eng-api): example config snippet to illustrate intent:
```
routes:
  chat:
    token_weight: 1
    max_burst: 1200
  embeddings:
    token_weight: 6
    max_burst: 300
org:
  burst_pool: 5000
  burst_policy: "shared_preemptible"
```

marta (eng-sre): telemetry we need: per-route token consumption histogram, time-to-429 by route, per-org burst_pool_utilization. add alerts for sustained >80% burst_pool usage. Grafana starter: `sum(rate(tokens_consumed_total[1m])) by (route,org)` and `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(token_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,route))`.

emma (eng-runtime): also expose client-visible headers so apps can backoff gracefully: `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `Retry-After`, and a new `X-Quota-Source: local|org-burst|reserved`.

kyle (eng-api): rollout plan: behind feature-flag `unified-burst-v1`. canary to 5% orgs for a week, collect delta on 429 rate, tail latency, and cost variance.

olivia (product): Console UX: surface per-route "burst credit" meter in Org Settings + breakdown per API key. add tooltip explaining token_weight and how embeddings cost more.

raj (eng-platform): blockers?

marta (eng-sre): billing needs to sign off — token_weight changes affect displayed cost metrics. we'll need a mapping layer for invoicing.

emma (eng-runtime): agreed. also need unit tests for the shim and some integration tests that simulate mixed chat+embeddings spikes.

kyle (eng-api): i'll open the runtime PR + feature-flag PR today, include the config and tests.

quota-bot: created ticket Q-4321: "unified burst design + telemetry" (assigned: eng-platform).

olivia (product): can we add a small FAQ blurb for SDK users? simple: "embeddings are weighted heavier; see X-Quota-Source header".

raj (eng-platform): ok — sync tomorrow 10:30am to align on telemetry and rollout metrics. :+1:

emma (eng-runtime): ack. :thumbsup:

kyle (eng-api): ack.

marta (eng-sre): ack.
